title: Copilot Studio: makers can require human approval before an agent runs a tool
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned approval toggle from the existing confirmation setting. The roadmap facts, documented control paths, PowerShell operation and general licensing requirements are supported; targeted searches did not establish documentation for the planned toggle's default, central enforcement or approval-specific billing.
